## Change / Modification Policy

Since your booking is **Business class** (not basic economy), changes **are permitted**. Here's what applies:

### ✅ What You Can Change
- **Flights** — You can change to a different flight, as long as the **origin (JFK)**, **destination (LHR)**, and **trip type (one-way)** remain the same.
- **Cabin class** — Can be changed (e.g., business → economy or vice versa), but it must be the same across all flights, and only if no portion of the trip has been flown yet.
- **Baggage** — You can **add** checked bags ($50 each for bags beyond free allowance). As a **Gold + Business** passenger, you get **4 free checked bags**. Bags cannot be removed.
- **Passenger info** — Names/details can be updated, but the **number of passengers cannot change**.

### ❌ What Cannot Be Changed
- **Origin or destination** cannot be altered.
- **Trip type** (one-way/round-trip) cannot be changed.
- **Insurance** cannot be added after booking.
- **Bags cannot be removed**, only added.

### 💰 Pricing for Changes
- If the new flight costs **more**, you'll be charged the **price difference**.
- If the new flight costs **less**, you'll receive a **refund** of the difference.

### 🔄 Cancellation Policy
As a **Business class** booking, cancellation is allowed regardless of timing. Since you also hold **Gold membership** and have **standard insurance**, you qualify for:
- **Full refund** to original payment method (Mastercard ending in 2449) within **5–7 business days**.
- If the airline cancels or your flight is delayed and you choose to cancel, you may also be eligible for a **travel certificate** as compensation ($100 × number of passengers).
